entries.25ac428785f5e447: In the acupuncture, moxibustion and bonesetting clinic industry, medical expense reimbursements are trending downward, and expanding self-pay treatments and merchandise sales has become an issue. The company addresses this issue through a management-support business centered on its core system.
entries.31b06a6766bdba08: The company’s corporate philosophy is “To make people all over the world healthy,” and it states that it will focus on making the services it provides function as infrastructure for acupuncture, moxibustion and bonesetting clinics.

entries.5c6ccd95cbe751ee: As its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company states that it will work on adding functions to the core system A-COMS and focus on increasing members of Atra Seikyu Service through switching from other services. It also states that it will work on expanding the platform for providing reverse aging, enriching content and holding seminars at Atra Academy, developing original equipment, increasing members of HONEY-STYLE and the clinics using it, developing franchise stores for Honetsugi Day Service, increasing user members of Atra Store, and improving the profitability of the toy store Pelican.

entries.6096098bbca6b224: Headquartered in Nishi-ku, Osaka, the group consists of the Company and 5 consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.61447941829a5e2a: In this business, the consolidated subsidiary Pelican Co., Ltd. sells toys, stationery and other goods at Pelican stores. It uses the store management guidance know-how developed through management support to bone-setting clinics and acupuncture and moxibustion bone-setting clinics. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,569 million.
entries.6d729e1b9835d376: This business provides management support to acupuncture and moxibustion bone-setting clinics. It includes providing the core system A-COMS and the Artra Billing Service, which handles claims for medical expense reimbursement on behalf of clinics; selling equipment and consumables for self-pay treatments; expanding the Honetsugi Chain; operating the product sales support system HONEY-STYLE and the Artra Academy; and franchising Honetsugi Day Services. It is carried out by the Company, Artra Finance Co., Ltd., Artra Care Co., Ltd., Artra Planning Co., Ltd., and Happy Life Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,357 million.
entries.713e605af0222ca6: Headquartered in Nishi-ku, Osaka, the group consists of the company and five consolidated subsidiaries. As of December 31, 2025, the number of employees was 131. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.78603881da93f05d: A company that supports the management of acupuncture and moxibustion and bonesetting clinics through core systems, billing agency services and more, and also operates a toy sales business.
entries.84fe31afb3c2e61c: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥258 million (net loss attributable to owners of the parent in the prior year was ¥36 million).
entries.88b495fc1dafebf5: The company states that its core system A-COMS has scalability and that services can easily be added to it. It also states that A-COMS functions as a mechanism to prevent fraudulent claims for medical expenses, and that it is a system promoting IT adoption, which had been lagging in the acupuncture, moxibustion and bonesetting clinic industry.
entries.8ce71f07dc2b976b: Revenue comes from service income from providing core systems and claims agency services for medical expenses, franchise fees and royalties, sales of equipment and consumables, and in-store sales of toys, stationery and other goods.
entries.8fb139bcc831c127: The main counterparts of the A-COMS Business are acupuncture, moxibustion and bonesetting clinics, as well as members of Honetsugi Chain and Honetsugi Day Service. In the Toy Sales Business, toys, stationery and other goods are sold to visitors to stores.
entries.975c489ac9a82278: Headquartered in Nishi-ku, Osaka, the group consists of the Company and 5 consolidated subsidiaries. It operates the A-COMS Business, which provides management support to acupuncture and moxibustion bone-setting clinics, and the Toy Sales Business. The number of employees as of December 31, 2025 is 131. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

entries.a384ed90c15bcbaf: For Atra Seikyu Service, the company has put in place a system covering everything from preparing establishment notification forms, to checking and submitting medical expense payment applications, handling returned claims, processing receipts and remittances, storing data, and responding to inquiries at its call center. It also provides the A-COMS Finance Service, which supports cash flow during the period before medical expenses are received.
entries.ad50c673a8b8d52d: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,357 million for the A-COMS Business and ¥1,569 million for the Toy Sales Business, totaling ¥3,927 million. Within the A-COMS Business, revenue from Atra Seikyu Service and HONEY-STYLE exceeded the prior year.
